payload.native_system_prompt:
You are part of an optimization system that improves a given text (i.e. the variable). You are the gradient (feedback) engine. Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. The variables may be solutions to problems, prompts to language models, code, or any other text-based variable. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. Only provide strategies, explanations, and methods to change in the variable. DO NOT propose a new version of the variable, that will be the job of the optimizer. Your only job is to send feedback and criticism (compute 'gradients'). For instance, feedback can be in the form of 'Since language models have the X failure mode...', 'Adding X can fix this error because...', 'Removing X can improve the objective function because...', 'Changing X to Y would fix the mistake ...', that gets at the downstream objective.
If a variable is already working well (e.g. the objective function is perfect, an evaluation shows the response is accurate), you should not give feedback.

### Glossary of tags that will be sent to you:
# - <LM_SYSTEM_PROMPT>: The system prompt for the language model.
# - <LM_INPUT>: The input to the language model.
# - <LM_OUTPUT>: The output of the language model.
# - <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION>: The objective of the optimization task.
# - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.
# - <ROLE>: The role description of the variable.
payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the image rendered as a pencil drawing?
node.criteria: Compare the source scene with the edited image across the whole frame. A pencil-drawing rendering requires recognizable graphite-like linework and tonal shading to replace the source's photographic rendering across the scene. Muted color, grain, or softened edges alone are not sufficient. Treat the endpoint as incomplete when substantial regions or major objects retain photographic forms, shading, or texture; full achievement requires the pencil-drawn treatment throughout the image, allowing natural variation in texture and lighting.
node.binding: Compare SOURCE with EDITED: assess whether the requested transformation renders the source image as a pencil drawing across the whole image. Judge visible treatment of the food, dishes, and surrounding background; do not count desaturation, grain, or unrelated changes alone as pencil-drawing fulfillment.
node.source_quote: Change the image into pencil drawing
node.endpoint: The image is rendered as a pencil drawing.
node.necessity: This is the requested transformation itself; without it, the instruction is not fulfilled.
node.zero_when: No requested pencil-drawing change is visible; unrelated edits do not count.
node.half_when: About half of the image’s visual content has a concrete pencil-drawn treatment, while substantial content remains in its original non-pencil rendering.
node.full_when: The image’s visual content is rendered throughout in a recognizable pencil-drawing style, with pencil-like linework and tonal shading replacing photographic rendering across the scene, allowing natural variation in texture and lighting. Muted color, grain, or softened edges alone do not establish full achievement.

node_traces.evidence: The edited image is substantially desaturated and softened, and some food and dish edges have a faint sketch-like appearance. However, much of the scene—including the pitcher, glass, tablecloth, and food—still has photographic forms and shading; recognizable graphite linework and pencil tonal treatment do not replace the photographic rendering throughout. This is a partial change, but muted color and softness alone do not meet the endpoint.
